description: A formula over wired inputs — arithmetic, comparison, && || !, ternary, min/floor/ceil/round, 'strings'. Write several 'name = expr' lines to compute AND output multiple values from one node.
instructions:
Evaluates through the safe expression engine (the same language as a pobj's `vars` / a declaration's `showWhen`).

TWO MODES:
• Single expression (e.g. `steps*tread`) → one output `val-result`.
• A BLOCK of `name = expr` lines → one `val-<name>` output PER line, evaluated top-to-bottom so a later line can use an earlier name (a `vars` block). One Expression node then replaces a whole chain of Math / Conditional / Match nodes.

INPUTS — combinable:
• Every INPUT variable (a free variable not defined by an earlier line) gets its own `valin-<var>` endpoint.
• The static `deps` endpoint merges a whole Parametric Object / Input Properties node's values into scope by name in ONE wire.
An explicit `valin-<var>` wire OVERRIDES deps.

LANGUAGE: + - * / %, comparisons, == != (on 'strings' too — `config == 'u-shape'`), && || !, cond ? a : b, min max floor ceil round abs sqrt pow sin cos tan atan2, PI.

EXAMPLE BLOCK:
  dir = direction == 'ltr' ? 1 : -1
  run = steps * tread * dir
  n1  = (midSteps>0 && midSteps<steps) ? midSteps : floor(steps/2)

`name` (the field) is just the node's header label.

parameters.label: Formula(s)
parameters.placeholder: one expression, OR several `name = expr` lines
